auth object with empty username in basic auth is rejected

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { AuthConfig, createEngine, scrape } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { auth: { password: "secret", type: "basic", username: "" } as AuthConfig };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  try {
    await scrape(engine, url);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof Error) {
      console.error(`${error.name}: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }
}

void main();
```
